protocol.rule: Same source-verified name/180-token overview/180-token best passage for both models; raw logit >=0 acceptance. Report positive-negative ordering separately. No threshold sweep. Stop before integration if any direct example is rejected or any judged negative accepted.
protocol.limitations: Diagnostic selected difficult topics, not blind validation; aliases share cases. Logits are not calibrated probabilities. Cases absent from retrieval are explicitly injected for this model-only test.
